tweetMedia.transcription: So guys, this is absolutely mind-blowing. So I was watching the most recent video by Nick Shirley exposing these daycare centers. Now, they're going daycare to daycare, and the next one that they go to is called Sweet Angel Child Care. This is where they show up to, and this is the business right here. Sweet Angel Child Care in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Now listen to where this phone number goes to when you call this child care center. Just wait for it. Thank you for contacting the office of Governor Tim Walz and Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan. Our office is located at 130 State Capitol at 75 Reverend. Oh my God I do it again Sweet Angel Child Care It goes to Governor Tim Walz office Why is a child care center directly going to the office of the governor? Make it make sense. Hold on. Thank you for contacting the office of Governor Tim Walz and Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan. If this is not a direct link to Tim Walz and these fraudulent child care centers, I don't know what else is. Bro, this is crazy. I'm just in shock right now. I was recording a YouTube video and reacting to this video. And I was like, let me call and look up their Google reviews. I was just looking up their Google reviews and I was like, let me call this number. And I call it and it goes to Governor Tim Watt's office. Make that make sense.
